description.value:
You always have the following spells prepared at the specified Artificer levels:

  • Level 3: False Life, Spare the Dying, Witch Bolt
  • Level 5: Blindness/Deafness, Enhance Ability
  • Level 9: Animate Dead, Lightning Bolt
  • Level 13: Blight, Death Ward
  • Level 17: Antilife Shell, Raise Dead

At 3rd level, when you cast Spare the Dying, you can modify the spell so that it sends a jolt of electricity through the target, reviving it:

  • The target regains 1 Hit Point.
  • Each creature in a 10-foot Emanation from the target makes a Dexterity saving throw against your spell save DC, taking Lightning damage equal to 1d4 plus half your Artificer level (round up) on a failed save, or half as much on a success.

You can modify the spell this way a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier, regaining all uses after a Long Rest.

At 3rd level, using Tinker's Tools or Artisan's Tools you are proficient with, you take a Magic action to create a Reanimated Companion (Medium Undead).

It takes its turn immediately after yours, obeys verbal commands, and attacks using your Intelligence modifier for attack and damage.
At 5th level, your reanimated companion gains surgical and alchemical upgrades of your choice: Acidic Spittle, Bony Carapace, Elastic Sinew, or Vile Vigor.
At 9th level, the lightning damage of Jolt to Life increases by 1d4, and the revived target regains HP equal to 1 + your Intelligence modifier. In addition, your companion can make two attacks.

At 15th level, your companion gains Immunity to Lightning damage and regenerates 5 HP at start of its turn when subjected to lightning. You can also cast Create Undead once per Long Rest without a spell slot.
At 3rd level, you learn the Guidance cantrip, which counts as a Bard spell for you and has a range of 60 feet. You can also use a candle, tarokka deck, or spirit board as a spellcasting focus.
At 3rd level, as a Bonus Action, you expend one use of Bardic Inspiration and roll on the Spirit Tales table to channel an otherworldly entity and bestow its magical tale onto a creature.
At 6th level, when you cast a Bard spell through your Spiritual Focus that deals damage or restores HP, you add 1d6 to the damage or healing.
At 14th level, whenever you roll on the Spirit Tales table, you roll two dice and choose which tale to manifest.

At 3rd level, when you cast a spell that restores HP to a creature at 0 HP, any dice rolled for healing use the highest possible result.

You also learn Spare the Dying with a range of 30 feet and can cast it as a Bonus Action.

You always have the following spells prepared:

  • Level 3: Bane, False Life
  • Level 5: Gentle Repose, Ray of Enfeeblement
  • Level 7: Revivify, Vampiric Touch
  • Level 9: Blight, Death Ward

name: Channel Divinity: Path to the Grave

description.value: As a Magic action, expend one use of Channel Divinity to curse a creature within 30 feet. The target has Vulnerability to all damage of the next hit dealt to it before end of your next turn.
At 6th level, when you or a creature within 30 feet suffers a Critical Hit, you can use a Reaction to negate the critical, turning it into a normal hit. Uses equal to Wisdom mod per Long Rest.
At 17th level, when you cast a Necromancy spell of 1st through 5th level that targets only one creature, you can target a second creature within range.
You always have the following spells prepared: Inflict Wounds, Pass without Trace, Animate Dead, Blight, and Contagion.
As a Bonus Action, your strikes are wreathed in hollow woodland spirits for 1 minute. Once per turn on a hit, deals extra 1d6 Necrotic or Cold damage and reduces the target's Speed by 10 feet.
At 7th level, when you deal damage with Wrath of the Wild, you gain Temporary HP equal to the damage dealt or grant it to an ally within 30 feet.
At 11th level, the damage of Wrath of the Wild increases to 1d10, and you can create a vortex of rot creating difficult terrain and dealing continuous damage.
At 15th level, when reduced to 0 HP, you drop to 1 HP instead and emit a necrotic burst within 30 feet dealing 3d10 damage and pushing enemies (1x per Long Rest).
At 3rd level, whenever you finish a Short or Long Rest, you can gain proficiency with one skill or tool of your choice until your next rest, guided by the dead.

At 3rd level, immediately after dealing Sneak Attack damage to a creature, you can cause a second creature within 30 feet to take Necrotic damage equal to half your Sneak Attack dice (round up).

Uses equal to Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
At 9th level, when a creature dies within 30 feet, take a Reaction to capture a soul sliver as a Soul Trinket (max = PB). While carrying one, you have Advantage on death saves and Con saves.
At 13th level, as a Bonus Action, assume a spectral form for 10 minutes: gain 10-foot Fly speed (hover), attacks against you have Disadvantage, and you can move through creatures and objects.
At 17th level, Wails from the Grave deals damage to both targets simultaneously. When you finish a Long Rest, a soul trinket manifests if you have none.
At 3rd level, you gain Darkvision up to 120 feet. You can also cast Darkness by expending 2 Sorcery Points and can see through the darkness created by this casting.
You always have the following spells prepared: False Life, Darkness, Fear, Evard's Black Tentacles, and Enervation.

At 6th level, as a Bonus Action, spend 3 Sorcery Points to summon a shadow hound next to an enemy within 120 feet. While the hound is within 5 feet, the target has Disadvantage on saving throws against your spells.
At 14th level, while in dim light or darkness, you can teleport as a Bonus Action up to 120 feet to an unoccupied space you can see that is also in dim light or darkness.
At 18th level, spend 5 Sorcery Points as a Bonus Action to transform into shadow for 1 minute: gain Resistance to all damage except Force and Radiant, and move through creatures/objects.
You always have the following spells prepared: Shield, Wrathful Smite, Blur, Branding Smite, Blink, Elemental Weapon, Phantasmal Killer, and Staggering Smite.

At 3rd level, curse an enemy within 30 feet as a Bonus Action for 1 minute:

  • Add your Proficiency Bonus to damage rolls against it.
  • Attack rolls against the cursed target crit on 19 or 20.
  • If the target dies, you regain HP equal to your Warlock level + Charisma mod.
  • Hex Warrior: Proficiency with Medium Armor, Shields, Martial Weapons, and use Charisma for weapon attack and damage.
At 6th level, when you slay a humanoid, use a Reaction to bind its spirit, raising it as an Accursed Specter under your command until your next Long Rest.
At 10th level, if your cursed target hits you with an attack roll, you can use a Reaction to roll 1d6: on a 4 or higher, the attack misses you regardless of the roll.
At 14th level, when the creature cursed by your Hexblade Manifest dies, you can transfer the curse to another creature within 30 feet without expending a new use.

At 3rd level, manifest an aspect of dread as a Bonus Action for 1 minute:

  • Gain Temporary HP equal to 1d10 + Warlock level.
  • Immune to Frightened condition.
  • Once per turn on a hit, force the target to make a Wisdom save or become Frightened of you until end of your next turn.

Uses equal to Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest.
You always have the following spells prepared: Bane, Blindness/Deafness, Speak with Dead, Death Ward, and Cloudkill.
At 6th level, you do not need to eat, drink, or breathe. Once per turn when dealing damage, you can replace the damage type with Necrotic and add one extra damage die.
At 10th level, gain Resistance to Necrotic damage (Immunity during Form of Dread). When reduced to 0 HP, explode dealing necrotic damage within 30 feet and revive with 1 HP (1x per Long Rest).

At 14th level, as a Magic action, project your spirit for 1 hour: 30-foot Fly speed (hover), resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing, and cast Conjuration/Necromancy spells with reduced components.
At 3rd level, gain proficiency in Arcana and Nature, and learn either Prestidigitation or Druidcraft using Intelligence.

At 3rd level, infuse ranged attacks with magical effects. Choose two Arcane Shot options (e.g., Banishing, Bursting, Enfeebling, Seeking, Shadow, Piercing).

You can use an Arcane Shot once per turn on a hit. You have 2 uses, regaining them on a Short or Long Rest.
At 7th level, when you miss with a ranged attack, take a Bonus Action to curve the shot toward another creature within 60 feet, making a new attack roll.
At 7th level, your ammunition counts as magical to overcome resistances and can create magical utility effects such as light beacons or anchoring ropes.
At 10th level, when you roll Initiative with no remaining uses of Arcane Shot, you immediately regain one use.
At 15th level, when you use Indomitable, release a shockwave that disorients adjacent foes or teleports you up to 30 feet.
At 18th level, the extra damage dealt by all of your Arcane Shot options increases from 2d6 to 4d6.
At 3rd level, your body is inscribed with mystical tattoos channeling your Focus. Your unarmed strikes can deal Force damage instead of bludgeoning.
At 3rd level, choose two beast tattoos (e.g., Tiger's Claw, Falcon's Wing, Turtle Shell, or Viper's Fang) gaining enhanced strikes and defense.
At 6th level, receive a celestial tattoo: gain Fly speed equal to your Speed when using Step of the Wind, and resistance to Radiant and Necrotic damage.
At 11th level, your nature tattoo absorbs elemental damage, infusing your unarmed strikes with fire, cold, or lightning.
At 17th level, manifest the titan tattoo: as a Bonus Action grow to Large size, gain condition immunities, and deal an extra 1d10 Force damage.
At 3rd level, as a Bonus Action, teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space or swap places with a willing creature. Recharges when casting a 1st+ level Conjuration spell.
Add two 1st- or 2nd-level Conjuration spells to your spellbook for free, and copying Conjuration spells takes half the gold and time.
At 6th level, the range of your Benign Transposition increases to 60 feet.
At 6th level, any creature you summon or create gains Temporary HP equal to twice your Wizard level.
At 10th level, while concentrating on a Conjuration spell, your concentration cannot be broken as a result of taking damage.
At 14th level, when casting a summon spell that creates one creature, you can manifest two creatures instead.
Add two Enchantment spells to your spellbook for free, and copying Enchantment spells takes half the gold and time.
At 3rd level, as a Magic action, force a creature within 5 feet to make a Wisdom save or be Charmed and Incapacitated until end of your next turn.
At 6th level, when you cast an Enchantment spell of 1st level or higher that targets only one creature, you can target a second creature.
At 10th level, when attacked, take a Reaction to force a Wisdom save on the attacker to redirect the attack to the nearest creature.
At 14th level, creatures you charm do not realize they were charmed, and you can make them forget periods of time.
Add two Necromancy spells to your spellbook for free, and copying Necromancy spells takes half the gold and time.
At 3rd level, learn a modified Necromancy cantrip and store soul fragments within your spellbook pages.
At 6th level, when you slay creatures with a spell of 1st+ level, regain HP equal to twice the spell level (three times for Necromancy).
At 6th level, add Animate Dead to spellbook. Undead you create have HP increased by Wizard level and add PB to damage rolls.
At 10th level, Resistance to Necrotic damage, max HP cannot be reduced, and absorb destroying undead thralls to heal yourself.
At 14th level, as a Magic action, force an undead creature within 60 feet to make a Charisma saving throw or become under your permanent command.
Add two Transmutation spells to your spellbook for free, and copying Transmutation spells takes half the gold and time.
At 3rd level, craft a magic stone granting its bearer a benefit: 60ft Darkvision, +10ft Speed, proficiency in Constitution saves, or elemental resistance.
At 3rd level, temporarily transmute mundane physical substances (wood to iron, stone to silver, etc.) during a rest.
At 6th level, your stone can confer two simultaneous benefits or be changed quickly.
At 10th level, the stone bearer can consume its charge to restore all HP or cure poisons and curses.
At 10th level, add Polymorph to spellbook and cast it on yourself without a spell slot (1x per Long Rest).
At 14th level, consume your stone to perform Major Transmutation: Panacea, Restore Youth, or Raise Dead.
You always have prepared: Magic Missile, Detect Magic, Magic Weapon, Misty Step, Dispel Magic, Haste, Arcane Eye, and Dimension Door.
At 3rd level, gain Arcana proficiency and learn two Wizard cantrips of your choice as Cleric spells.
At 6th level, when healing an ally with a 1st+ level spell, also end one spell of equal or lower level affecting the target.
At 17th level, choose four Wizard spells (one each of 6th, 7th, 8th, and 9th level) to add to your prepared Cleric spells.
You always have prepared: Bless, Prayer of Healing, Spirit Guardians, Death Ward, and Commune.
At 3rd level, consult ancestor spirits for a 1d4 bonus on skill checks and spend 1 Sorcery Point for Advantage on mental saves.
At 6th level, ancestors shield you: unarmored AC becomes 13 + Charisma mod, and you can intercept damage for nearby allies.
At 14th level, summon an ancestral spirit warrior by spending 4 Sorcery Points without expending a spell slot.
At 18th level, as a Bonus Action become the living vessel of your bloodline for 1 minute: weapon resistance, 60ft Fly speed, and reroll spell damage dice.

At 3rd level, you learn to invoke the primal wisdom of the Moonshae Isles. As a Bonus Action, you can expend one Bardic Inspiration die and roll it to channel a blessed folk legend:

  • 1–2 (The Beast): An ally within 30 ft gains Temporary HP equal to the roll + your Cha modifier, and its next melee attack deals extra cold damage equal to the roll.
  • 3–4 (The Earthmother): An ally within 30 ft regains HP equal to the roll + your Cha modifier, and ends one poison or disease affecting it.
  • 5–6+ (The White Well): An ally within 30 ft can use its reaction to teleport up to 30 ft to an unoccupied space it can see and gains Advantage on its next saving throw.

At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in Nature and Survival. Whenever you make an Int (Nature) or Wis (Survival) check, you can add your Cha modifier to the check. In addition, you learn the Druidcraft cantrip.

At 6th level, the sacred water of the moonwells restores your soul. Once per day when you finish a Short Rest, you regain one expended use of Bardic Inspiration. Additionally, you can cast Moonbeam once without expending a spell slot per Long Rest.

At 14th level, your stories resonate with ancient power. Whenever you roll your Bardic Inspiration die for Moonshae Folktales, you roll two dice instead of one and can choose which result to use, or apply both results to two different allies within range.

You always have the following spells prepared at the specified Cleric levels:

  • Level 3: Command, Identify, Detect Thoughts, Mind Spike
  • Level 5: Nondetection, Tongues
  • Level 7: Arcane Eye, Confusion
  • Level 9: Legend Lore, Scrying
At 3rd level, you learn two languages of your choice. You also gain proficiency and Expertise in two of the following skills: Arcana, History, Nature, or Religion.
At 3rd level, whenever you cast an Enchantment or Divination spell using a spell slot, you can do so without needing Verbal or Somatic components.

At 6th level, your mind becomes an unassailable redoubt. You have Advantage on saving throws against being Charmed or Frightened. Furthermore, you can use your Channel Divinity to read surface thoughts of a creature or cleanse the Charmed and Frightened conditions from allies within 30 ft.

At 17th level, your connection to divine omniscience reaches its apex. You gain Truesight out to 30 ft. As a Reaction when an enemy within 60 ft makes an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, you can impose Disadvantage on that roll.
At 3rd level, you are trained as a diplomatic vanguard of Cormyr. You gain proficiency in Persuasion (or Animal Handling/Insight) and gain Expertise in Persuasion.

At 3rd level, you form a bond with a purple dragon wyrmling companion that fights beside you. It takes its turn immediately after yours, uses your Proficiency Bonus, and can deliver psionic breath or draconic strikes.

At 7th level, your dragon companion grows large enough to serve as your combat mount. Mounting or dismounting costs only 5 ft of movement, and you have Advantage on saving throws to avoid falling off your mount.
At 10th level, when you use your Second Wind, you can choose up to three allies within 60 ft. Each one regains Hit Points equal to your Fighter level or your Second Wind roll.
At 15th level, amethyst energy shields you and your mount. You and your dragon gain resistance to Force and Psychic damage, and the dragon's breath weapon range is doubled and damage increased.
At 18th level, when you use your Action Surge, one ally of your choice within 60 ft can use its reaction to make one weapon attack or cast a cantrip.
At 3rd level, when you cast Divine Smite, you can choose to deal Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage instead of Radiant damage.

You always have the following spells prepared at the specified Paladin levels:

  • Level 3: Absorb Elements, Thunderous Smite, Misty Step, Phantasmal Force
  • Level 5: Fly, Protection from Energy
  • Level 9: Banishment, Fire Shield
  • Level 13: Conjure Elemental, Creation

At 3rd level, you can use your Channel Divinity to manifest noble genie power: gain flying speed equal to your walking speed for 10 minutes, or unleash a 15-ft cone of elemental energy dealing 2d8 + Paladin level damage.

At 7th level, you emanate a 10-ft aura of elemental warding. Whenever you finish a rest, choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder. You and allies in the aura have resistance to the chosen damage type. Extends to 30 ft at 18th level.
At 15th level, when a creature within 30 ft hits you or an ally in your aura, you can use a reaction to retaliate, dealing 2d10 + Cha modifier elemental damage to the attacker.
At 20th level, as a Bonus Action, you take on the avatar of a noble genie sultan for 1 minute: flying speed 60 ft (hover), resistance to all 5 elemental damage types, and enhanced spell power.
At 3rd level, you ignore difficult terrain created by ice or snow, and you are adapted to extreme cold climates. You also gain resistance to Cold damage.

At 3rd level, once per turn when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can encase it in frost: it takes an extra 1d6 Cold damage and its speed is reduced by 10 ft until the start of your next turn.

You always have the following spells prepared at the specified Ranger levels:

  • Level 3: Armor of Agathys, Ice Knife, Hold Person, Rime's Binding Ice
  • Level 5: Sleet Storm, Slow
  • Level 9: Ice Storm, Resilient Sphere
  • Level 13: Cone of Cold, Hold Monster
At 7th level, whenever you deal Cold damage with a weapon attack or ranger spell, you gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Wisdom modifier (minimum 1).

At 11th level, Hunter's Rime damage increases to 1d10. Furthermore, when an enemy within 5 ft hits you with a melee attack, it takes 2d8 Cold damage and must succeed on a Con save or have Disadvantage on its next attack.

At 15th level, you can manifest the avatar of unrelenting winter for 1 minute: emanate a 15-ft blizzard (difficult terrain for enemies, 2d6 cold damage at start of enemy turn) and you can pass through solid creatures and objects.

At 3rd level, when you score a Critical Hit or drop a creature to 0 HP with Sneak Attack, you gain Temporary HP equal to your Rogue level + Dex modifier and can immediately move up to half your speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

At 3rd level, you swear dark fealty to one of the Dead Three:

  • Bane (Tyranny): Proficiency in Intimidation, advantage on saves against fear, and +PB Force damage.
  • Bhaal (Murder): Critical hit on 19–20 against bloodied creatures (at or below half HP).
  • Myrkul (Death): Sneak Attack can deal Necrotic damage, and you learn Spare the Dying and False Life.
At 9th level, when you hit with Sneak Attack, the target must succeed on a Wisdom save (DC 8 + PB + Dex mod) or have the Frightened condition until the end of your next turn.
At 13th level, you emanate a 10-ft aura of chilling dread. Enemies in your aura have Disadvantage on saves against fear, and you and allies gain resistance to Necrotic damage.

At 17th level, once per Long Rest, you channel the dark mantle of the Dead Three for 1 minute: gain resistance to all damage except radiant, maximize Sneak Attack damage on your first hit each turn, and frightened enemies take 4d6 necrotic damage at start of their turns.

At 3rd level, you channel the raw silver flame of magic. When you cast a spell that deals Fire or Radiant damage, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to ignore resistance and force targets to make a Con save or be Blinded until the start of your next turn.

You always have the following spells prepared at the specified Sorcerer levels:

  • Level 3: Burning Hands, Guiding Bolt, Scorching Ray, Lesser Restoration
  • Level 5: Daylight, Fireball
  • Level 7: Fire Shield, Wall of Fire
  • Level 9: Flame Strike, Dawn

At 6th level, as a Reaction when targeted by a spell or inside a spell's area of effect, you can spend 1 Sorcery Point to gain Advantage on the saving throw. If you succeed, you regain Sorcery Points equal to the spell's level (minimum 1).
At 14th level, you can direct spellfire to heal allies. As an Action, you can spend up to your Cha modifier in Sorcery Points to heal a creature within 30 ft: 1d10 HP per Sorcery Point spent.

At 18th level, as a Bonus Action by spending 5 Sorcery Points, you ignite the Crown of Spellfire for 1 minute: gain flying speed 60 ft (hover), immunity to Fire and Radiant damage, and all your spells deal bonus damage equal to your Cha modifier.

At 3rd level, you invoke the elven art of the Bladesong. As a Bonus Action (uses = Proficiency Bonus per Long Rest), you start the Bladesong for 1 minute, gaining:

  • Bonus to AC equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum +1).
  • Walking speed increases by 10 ft.
  • Advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks.
  • Bonus to Constitution saves to maintain concentration equal to your Int modifier (minimum +1).
At 3rd level, you gain proficiency with Light Armor, one one-handed melee weapon of your choice, and the Performance skill.
At 6th level, you can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn. Moreover, you can cast one of your cantrips in place of one of those attacks.
At 10th level, while your Bladesong is active and you take damage, you can use your reaction to expend one spell slot and reduce that damage by five times the slot's level.
At 14th level, while your Bladesong is active, you can add your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1) to the damage of your melee weapon attacks.

You always have the following spells prepared at the specified Druid levels:

  • Level 3: Goodberry, Purify Food and Drink, Barkskin, Lesser Restoration
  • Level 5: Create Food and Water, Plant Growth
  • Level 7: Aura of Life, Death Ward
  • Level 9: Greater Restoration, Reincarnate

At 3rd level, by expending a use of Wild Shape, you sanctify a 20-ft radius area centered on you for 1 minute. Allies inside gain resistance to Necrotic damage and regain extra HP equal to your Wis modifier whenever healed.
At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in Medicine and Herbalism Kit, and have Advantage on checks to forage food or pure water in wastelands.
At 6th level, allies within your Preserved Land add 1d4 to all saving throws. Enemies entering or starting their turn in the area take Radiant damage equal to your Wis modifier.
At 10th level, you can cast Lesser Restoration as a Bonus Action without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Wis modifier per Long Rest.
At 14th level, your Preserved Land expands to 30 ft radius. When an ally in the area is reduced to 0 HP, it drops to 1 HP instead (once per creature per rest).

At 3rd level, you learn crowd-pleasing brutality. You gain 3 Brutality dice (d6s, becoming d8s at 10th and d10s at 18th). You can spend a Brutality die on weapon attacks to add to damage, knock prone, disarm, or impose disadvantage.
At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in Performance and Athletics. You can add your Cha modifier to Initiative rolls instead of Dex.

At 7th level, as a Reaction when hit by a melee attack, spend 1 Brutality die, roll it, add your PB, and reduce the incoming damage. If reduced to 0, make an immediate melee attack against the attacker.
At 10th level, your Brutality dice become d8s. Whenever you use Second Wind, you regain 1 expended Brutality die.
At 15th level, when you roll initiative and have no Brutality dice remaining, you immediately regain 2 Brutality dice.
At 18th level, your Brutality dice become d10s. On a Critical Hit, you do not expend the Brutality die used, and the target's speed is halved until it receives magical healing.

At 3rd level, when casting a spell of 1st level or higher, you wither the life in a 10-ft emanation. Vegetation dies, and living creatures take Necrotic damage equal to the spell's level. You gain +1 to spell attack rolls and spell save DC for that casting.

You always have the following spells prepared at the specified Sorcerer levels:

  • Level 3: Inflict Wounds, Ray of Sickness, Blindness/Deafness, Ray of Enfeeblement
  • Level 5: Animate Dead, Vampiric Touch
  • Level 7: Blight, Shadow of Moil
  • Level 9: Cloudkill, Contagion
At 6th level, you gain resistance to Necrotic and Poison damage, and immunity to the Poisoned condition.
At 14th level, you project a 15-ft aura of decay: enemies inside have Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws. When an enemy dies in your aura, you regain 1 Sorcery Point.

At 18th level, your Withering Aura expands to 30 ft and prevents enemies inside from regaining Hit Points. Spending 4 Sorcery Points allows you to incinerate terrain in 60 ft, dealing 6d10 necrotic damage to all enemies in the area (Con save half).

You always have the following spells prepared at the specified Warlock levels:

  • Level 3: Command, Compelled Duel, Hold Person, Mind Spike, Wrathful Smite
  • Level 5: Fear, Sending
  • Level 7: Compulsion, Staggering Smite
  • Level 9: Dominate Person, Synaptic Static

Psionic Casting: You can cast these spells without Verbal or Material components (unless consumed or with monetary cost).

At 3rd level, you gain proficiency and Expertise in Intimidation. Additionally, you can cast Command as a Bonus Action without expending a spell slot a number of times equal to your Cha modifier per Long Rest.

At 6th level, when casting a spell using a Pact Magic slot, emit a 30-ft emanation. For each creature inside, choose:

  • Marshal: Ally gains Advantage on attack rolls until the end of its next turn.
  • Oppress: Enemy must pass a Wis save or be Frightened until the end of its next turn.

Recharges on Short/Long Rest, or upon using Magical Cunning.

At 10th level, as a Reaction when hit by an attack, force the enemy to reroll the d20 and use the new roll. If the attack misses, the creature takes Psychic damage equal to your Warlock level (uses = Cha mod per Long Rest).
At 14th level, whenever you cast Command, you can target one additional creature. Furthermore, creatures Frightened by you automatically fail saving throws against your Command.

At 3rd level, you channel arcane discipline into martial mastery. You learn cantrips and spells from the Sorcerer spell list (Abjuration and Evocation), using Wisdom as your spellcasting ability with third-caster progression.
At 6th level, when you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one unarmed strike as a Bonus Action.
At 6th level, you can spend 1 Focus Point (Ki) to cast a prepared 1st-level spell without expending a spell slot, or empower your unarmed strikes with 1d8 elemental damage for 1 minute.
At 11th level, whenever you make a Constitution save to maintain concentration on a spell, you can spend 1 Focus Point to automatically succeed.
At 17th level, when you cast a spell of 1st level or higher as an Action, you can make two unarmed strikes as a Bonus Action, or spend 2 Focus Points to cast the spell as a Bonus Action.
At 3rd level, as an Action, forge a protective bond with an ally within 30 ft. When that ally takes damage, you can use your Reaction to absorb half that damage yourself.

At 3rd level, when you hit a concentrating creature with a melee attack, it has Disadvantage on the concentration check. If it loses concentration, it takes extra Force damage equal to your Paladin level.

You always have the following spells prepared at the specified Paladin levels:

  • Level 3: Detect Magic, Shield, Misty Step, Silence
  • Level 5: Counterspell, Dispel Magic
  • Level 9: Banishment, Otiluke's Resilient Sphere
  • Level 13: Circle of Power, Dispel Evil and Good
At 7th level, you emanate a 10-ft aura: you and allies in the aura have Advantage on saves to maintain concentration on spells and gain resistance to spell damage. Expands to 30 ft at 18th level.
At 15th level, when you hit a creature with a weapon attack, you can cast Dispel Magic on the target as part of the attack without expending a spell slot (uses = Cha mod per Long Rest).

At 20th level, as a Bonus Action, manifest the supreme aegis of the Spellguard for 1 minute: immunity to spells of 1st-3rd level, advantage on all saves against spells, and whenever a spell fails to affect you, the caster takes 3d10 Force damage.

At 3rd level, when you hit with Sneak Attack against a spellcaster or touch a magical object, siphon residual energy into a Stolen Magic Charge (max = Proficiency Bonus). Spend charges to cast Detect Magic or Dispel Magic.
At 3rd level, when you deal Sneak Attack damage, spend 1 Stolen Magic Charge to convert all damage to Force damage and add +1d6 damage.
At 9th level, you can use Cunning Action to disarm magical glyphs, wards, or continuous magical effects within 30 ft using thieves' tools and Arcana.
At 13th level, when using Uncanny Dodge against damage from a spell or magical effect, you can spend 1 Stolen Magic Charge to become Invisible until the end of your next turn.

At 13th level, your max Stolen Magic Charges increases to PB + 2. As a Reaction when a creature within 30 ft casts a spell, make a ranged weapon attack: if it hits, siphon the spell, negating it if 1st-2nd level, or imposing disadvantage on its concentration.

At 17th level, as an Action, spend 3 Stolen Magic Charges to detonate an arcane implosion in a 20-ft radius sphere up to 60 ft away. Enemies take 10d10 Force damage (Dex save half) and all active spells of 5th level or lower in the area are dispelled.

At 3rd level, you bind the spectral remnant of a forgotten entity. It manifests as an ephemeral companion that acts on your turn, attacks using your spell attack modifier, deals Psychic or Force damage, and can fly through solid objects.

You always have the following spells prepared at the specified Warlock levels:

  • Level 3: Heroism, Unseen Servant, Invisibility, Spiritual Weapon
  • Level 5: Phantom Steed, Spirit Guardians
  • Level 7: Death Ward, Phantasmal Killer
  • Level 9: Contact Other Plane, Mislead
At 6th level, when you or your vestige companion reduce an enemy to 0 HP, you gain Temporary HP equal to your Warlock level + Cha mod, and the vestige can immediately teleport up to 30 ft.
At 10th level, your vestige companion projects a 10-ft aura: allies inside add 1d4 to attack rolls and saving throws.

At 14th level, your vestige companion can assume full corporeal power for 1 minute: gains resistance to all damage, 40 ft flying speed (hover), and can channel your prepared Warlock spells using its own reaction or bonus action.

At 3rd level, the Unlight coursing through you fuels your Rage. If a creature hits you with a melee attack roll while your Rage is active, the creature takes Radiant damage equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

Additionally, while your Rage is active, you shed Bright Light in a 20-foot radius.

At 6th level, you have proficiency in the Perception skill, if you lack it. You also gain Expertise in that skill.

While your Rage is active, you have Blindsight with a range equal to that of the Bright Light provided by your Radiant Rage.

At 10th level, damage you deal with Brutal Strike can be Radiant or the usual type (your choice). The following effect is now among your Brutal Strike options:

Radiant Infection: The target becomes infected with Unlight for 1 minute. While infected, it sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius. Additionally, at the start of each of its turns, the target takes 1d6 Radiant damage. The target makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus) at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
At 10th level, you have Resistance to Radiant damage.

At 14th level, the aura of your Unlight is bolstered. While your Rage is active, you shed Bright Light in a 30-foot radius.

As a Bonus Action, you unleash blinding brilliance. When you do, each creature of your choice within 30 feet of you makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 plus your Strength modifier and Proficiency Bonus). On a failed save, a creature takes 1d12 Radiant damage and has the Blinded condition until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage only.

Once you use this feature, you can’t use it again until you finish a Long Rest unless you expend a use of your Rage (no action required) to restore your use of it.

At 3rd level, you gain a magical token in the form of a brooch or coin that marks you as an agent of your sponsor and bears their heraldry. Charisma is your spellcasting ability for spells cast with your insignia:

  • Cantrips: You learn the Friends cantrip.
  • Find Familiar: You can cast Find Familiar only as a Ritual, choosing the Spider form.
  • Insignia Spells: 3rd level: Charm Person; 5th level: Suggestion; 9th level: Hypnotic Pattern. Once you cast an insignia spell, you can't cast it again until you finish a Long Rest.

At 3rd level, you can take the Influence action as a Bonus Action. Additionally, choose one of the following skills: Deception, Intimidation, Performance, or Persuasion. You have proficiency in that skill.

At 9th level, you have Advantage on attack rolls against creatures within 5 feet of you that are Friendly to you or have the Charmed Condition. You also gain the following Cunning Strike option:

Stunning Betrayal (Cost: 4d6): If your target was Friendly to you or had the Charmed condition when you hit it, the target has the Stunned condition until the start of your next turn.
At 13th level, a creature’s Hostile attitude doesn’t impose Disadvantage on your Charisma checks to influence that creature.

At 13th level, the familiar you have through the Find Familiar spell gains Darkvision with a range of 120 feet and Truesight with a range of 30 feet.

Additionally, when you cast the Find Familiar spell or finish a Short or Long Rest while you have a familiar, you can grant your familiar Temporary Hit Points equal to your Rogue level.

At 17th level, you gain the following Cunning Strike option:

Confound (Cost: 5d6): The target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw with a DC equal to your spellcasting DC or have the Charmed condition for 1 minute. The target can repeat the save when it takes any damage, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Additionally, you can cast the Friends spell as a Bonus Action without its usual humanoid/combat immunities. When a spell you cast that causes the Charmed condition ends, the target doesn’t know it was Charmed by you.

At 3rd level, you know how to weave Unlight into your damaging spells. When you cast a spell that deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage, you can change that damage type to Radiant.

In addition, Dim Light created by spells you cast is Bright Light instead.

At 3rd level, as a Bonus Action, choose a willing creature you can see within 30 feet of you and roll one or two of your Hit Point Dice. Those dice are expended. The target gains Temporary Hit Points equal to the total rolled plus your Intelligence modifier, and until the target has no Temporary Hit Points, it has Advantage on Strength checks and sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius.

At 6th level, as a Bonus Action, choose a creature you can see within 30 feet of you and roll one or two of your Hit Point Dice. Those dice are expended. The target regains Hit Points equal to the total rolled and sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius until the end of its next turn.

If you expended two Hit Point Dice, you can choose to end one of the following conditions on the target: Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned instead of restoring Hit Points.

At 10th level, your research into the Imaskarcana grants you the following benefits:

  • Imaskarcana Lore: You can attune yourself to a magic item as a Magic action (once per Long Rest).
  • Piercing Unlight: Your spells ignore Resistance to Radiant damage.
  • Unlight Resilience: You gain Resistance to Radiant damage.
  • Imaskar Seals: You always have Glyph of Warding prepared and can cast it once per Long Rest without expending a spell slot or material components, cast at your highest available Wizard spell slot level.

At 14th level, when a creature takes Radiant damage from a spell you cast, you can use a Reaction to curse it. The target makes a Constitution save against your spell save DC. On a failure, it suffers:

  • Sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius; attacks against it have Advantage.
  • Takes Radiant damage equal to your character level at the start of each of its turns.
  • Has Advantage on Strength checks and melee attacks; hitting another creature allows it to repeat the save to end the curse.
  • If reduced to 0 HP, it explodes: creatures within 10 ft take Radiant damage equal to half your level in d8s.

Recharges on a Long Rest or by expending a 6th+ level spell slot.

activation.condition: Quando criatura sofre Dano Radiante de magia sua

description.value:
At 3rd level, when you activate your Rage or as a Bonus Action while your Rage is active, you can let out a doleful wail. Each creature of your choice in a 30-foot Emanation makes a Constitution saving throw (DC 8 + Con mod + PB). On a failed save, a creature takes Psychic damage equal to a number of d12s equal to your Rage Damage bonus and has the Deafened condition for 1 minute. On a successful save, half damage only.

Uses equal to your Constitution modifier per Long Rest, or expend a Rage use to restore all uses.
At 6th level, you can cast the Speak with Dead spell but only as a Ritual. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability for it.

At 6th level, once per turn when you hit a creature with a Strength-based attack roll while your Rage is active, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw (DC 8 + Con mod + PB) or have the Frightened condition until the start of your next turn.

At 10th level, you gain the following benefits:

  • Deathly Wail: If a target fails against Banshee’s Wail and has HP equal to twice your Barbarian level or fewer, it drops to 0 HP instead of taking damage.
  • Impenetrable Sorrow: You can’t be possessed.
  • Resistance: You have Resistance to Cold and Necrotic damage while your Rage is active.

At 14th level, when you activate your Rage, you can empower yourself with undeath for 1 minute:

  • Immunities: Immunity to Charmed and Frightened conditions, and cannot gain Exhaustion levels.
  • Life-Draining Strike: When a creature fails against Horrifying Strike, it takes 2d10 Necrotic damage and you regain HP equal to the Necrotic damage dealt.
  • Undead: Your creature type is Undead.

Recharges after a Long Rest.

At 3rd level, at the start of your turn, you can expend 1 Focus Point to apply a toxin from your blood to a Monk weapon you're holding. A creature hit takes one effect:

  • Slowing Toxin: Until start of your next turn, target's Speed is halved; cannot take Reactions; and can take an action or Bonus Action on its turn, not both.
  • Venom: The target takes Poison damage equal to two rolls of your Martial Arts die.

Lasts 1 minute or until the weapon deals damage.

At 3rd level, you gain a Poisoner’s Kit and proficiency with it. You can craft Basic Poison over 1 day (8 hours). Additionally, whenever you deal Poison damage with a Monk feature or weapon, you can change that damage type to Acid.

At 6th level, as a Magic action, expend 1 Focus Point to touch a creature. On a failed Con save, it is Poisoned for 1 minute and gains one effect:

  • Intoxicant: Charmed until damaged.
  • Sedative: Unconscious until shaken awake as an action.
  • Truth Serum: Cannot knowingly lie for the duration.

At 11th level, you gain Immunity to Poison damage. When subjected to Poison damage, your Envenom Weapon deals extra Poison damage equal to one Martial Arts die. Ingesting poison restores HP equal to one Martial Arts die roll.
At 11th level, when a creature hits you with a melee attack roll, it takes 1d6 Poison damage. If you are Bloodied, it takes Poison damage equal to one roll of your Martial Arts die instead.

At 17th level, as part of the Attack action, spend 2 Focus Points to replace one attack with hallucinogenic breath at a creature within 30 feet. Con save: on failure, takes 3 Martial Arts dice of Poison damage and is Frightened for 1 minute (dashing away on turns); half damage on success.

At 3rd level, as a Magic action, create a 5-foot-radius Sphere of elemental magic within 60 feet. As a Bonus Action on later turns, move it up to 30 feet.

Dex save: 1d6 damage of chosen element (Air: Thunder, Earth: Acid, Fire: Fire, Water: Cold) on failure, half on success. Damage increases to 2d6 at 6th level and 3d6 at 14th level. Lasts 1 minute. Recharges on Short or Long Rest, or expend a Pact Magic slot.
At 3rd level, you always have certain primordial spells prepared along with spells corresponding to your chosen element (Air, Earth, Fire, or Water) at levels 3, 5, 7, and 9.
At 6th level, while inside your Elemental Node, you add your Charisma modifier to AC (min +1). As a Bonus Action, teleport into your node or within 5 ft of it (uses equal to Cha mod per Long Rest).
At 10th level, you have Resistance to your chosen element’s damage type. Inside your node, you are Immune to that damage type. Your Elemental Node becomes a 10-foot-radius Sphere.

At 14th level, when expending a slot inside your node, pull a creature within 30 ft up to 15 ft toward center on a failed Str save. Node lasts up to 1 hour. Can cast Planar Ally without a spell slot inside node once per 2d4 Long Rests.

At 3rd level, you always have the listed spells prepared: 3rd: Enlarge/Reduce, Thaumaturgy, Thunderwave; 5th: Fear; 7th: Fire Shield; 9th: Destructive Wave. You can cast these spells while in Titan Form.

At 3rd level, Wild Shape lets you assume a Titan Form (Behemoth, Leviathan, or Insectoid) for 10 minutes:

  • Temp HP: 4x Druid level; AC: 13 + Wis mod.
  • Strength and Dexterity scores equal your Wisdom score.
  • Rend attack (10 ft reach, 1d8+Wis, scaling to 2d8 at lv 6 and 3d8 at lv 12). Multiattack at lv 5. Siege Monster.
  • Form-specific abilities: Behemoth (Climb 40ft, Incandescent Breath), Leviathan (Swim 40ft, Amphibious, Toxic Deluge), Insectoid (Fly 40ft at lv 10, Energizing Pollen).

At 6th level, your Titan Form features gain enhancements:

  • Elemental Rend: Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder damage on Rend hits.
  • Shock Wave: Once per turn after moving half your Speed, emit a 10-ft Emanation: Con save or knocked Prone.
At 10th level, you can become Huge when assuming Titan Form. Expend a spell slot on transformation to gain +half slot level to AC. Ignore difficult terrain from rubble, snow, ice, or undergrowth.

At 14th level, you can become Gargantuan. Grapple on Rend hit. Bonus Action Swallow a grappled Large or smaller creature on failed Str save: swallowed creature is Blinded and Restrained, has Total Cover, and takes Wis mod d12 Acid damage each turn.
At 3rd level, you gain Devil’s Sight (120 ft normal sight in darkness and magical darkness), learn Infernal (or another language), and gain proficiency in Deception, Performance, or Sleight of Hand.
At 3rd level, when taking the Attack action, imbue weapons with hellfire. Sheds Dim Light in 5 ft, and damage can be Cold, Fire, or Necrotic (chosen when imbued).

At 3rd level, when hitting with Hell-Forged Weapon, add 1d6 extra damage and inflict an infernal wound. Wounded target takes 1d6 damage at start of its turns for 1 minute or until healed/stanched. Uses equal to Con mod per Short or Long Rest.

At 7th level, choose an advanced effect when rolling Infernal Wound Die: Purulence of Minauros (Acid + Poisoned), Rupture of Cania (Force damage), or Stygian Gangrene (Cold + no reactions). Rolling a 6 triggers Devil’s Luck enhancements.
At 7th level, gain Resistance to Cold, Fire, or Necrotic while wearing Heavy armor or wielding a Shield. When you roll your Infernal Wound Die, treat a roll of 1 as a 6.

At 10th level, using Action Surge with Hell-Forged Weapon emits a 20-foot Emanation until end of your next turn. Wounded creatures starting turns within take two Infernal Wound dice of damage instead of one.
At 15th level, Reaction to roll Infernal Wound Die and reduce damage from a wounded attacker (roll again on a 6, max 3 dice). Critical hits against you become normal hits.

activation.condition: Quando criatura com ferida infernal atinge você

description.value: At 18th level, rolling three 6s on your Infernal Wound Die before next turn grants Heroic Inspiration. Expend it within 120 ft to force a d20 reroll: success recharges Indomitable or Second Wind; failure causes you to lose 3d6 + Fighter level HP.

At 3rd level, using Innate Sorcery creates a 10-foot-radius Abyssal rupture within 30 feet. Move it 30 ft at start of turn. Bonus Action option: Demonic Lash (melee spell attack, 1d8 slashing + pull 10 ft) or Terrifying Screams (Wis save or 1d4 psychic damage).

At 3rd level, you always have Demonic Spells prepared: 3rd: Bane, Dissonant Whispers, Spike Growth, Web; 5th: Bestow Curse, Dispel Magic; 7th: Giant Insect, Hallucinatory Terrain; 9th: Contact Other Plane, Modify Memory.

At 6th level, spending 1+ Sorcery Points allows you to fill your Rupture or a 10-ft Emanation with Abyssal influence: Gaping Maw’s Frenzy (forced movement on Cha fail), Maze of Azzatar (Invisible against targets on Int fail), or Slime Pits’ Haze (Charmed or Poisoned on Con fail).

At 14th level, Rupture radius becomes 30 feet and difficult terrain for enemies. Always have Summon Fiend prepared; can cast it without Concentration for 1 minute (Demon form), gaining Advantage on attacks within Rupture.

At 18th level, as a Magic action, fill a 30-foot-radius Sphere with Abyssal explosion. Con save: 8d6 Force damage (non-fiends) and Incapacitated until start of next turn on failure; half damage on success. Recharges on Long Rest or 7 Sorcery Points.

At 3rd level, hitting a creature while raging triggers spectral warriors to cause one effect: Distract (Disadvantage on attacks vs others), Protect (ally gains Resistance to target's next hit), or Strike (extra 1d6 Acid, Cold, Fire, Force, Lightning, or Thunder damage).

At 6th level, while your Rage is active, when another creature you can see within 30 feet of you takes damage, use a Reaction to reduce that damage by rolling a number of d6s equal to your Rage Damage bonus.

description.value: At 10th level, cast Augury or Clairvoyance without a spell slot or material components. Wisdom is your spellcasting ability. Recharges on a Short or Long Rest.
At 14th level, rolling 18–20 on a melee weapon attack roll allows you to make one additional attack roll with the same weapon as part of that action (once per turn).

activation.condition: Ao rolar 18-20 em ataque corpo a corpo

description.value:
At 3rd level, entering Rage extends a 10-foot Emanation aura (Desert, Sea, or Tundra). Activates on Rage and as a Bonus Action on subsequent turns (DC 8 + Con mod + PB):

  • Desert: (Rage bonus)d4 Fire damage in aura on failed Dex save.
  • Sea: (Rage bonus)d6 Lightning damage to one creature in aura (half on Dex save).
  • Tundra: Target in aura subtracts (Rage bonus)d4 from next damage roll on failed Str save.

At 6th level, gain passive benefits based on last Storm Aura choice: Desert (Fire resistance, ignite objects), Sea (Lightning resistance, breathe water, swim speed), Tundra (Cold resistance, freeze 5-ft cube of water).
At 10th level, each creature of your choice within your Storm Aura has the damage Resistance you have from the Storm Soul feature.

At 14th level, Storm Aura upgrades: Desert (ignites targets for 2d4 fire damage at turn start), Sea (lightning chains to a second target within 30 ft), Tundra (deals 2d4 Cold damage and halves target’s Speed).
At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance, or Persuasion, or you learn one language of your choice.
At 3rd level, Advantage on saving throws to avoid falling off mount, land on feet if falling 10 ft or less, and mounting/dismounting costs only 5 ft of movement.

At 3rd level, hit with melee weapon marks a creature until end of next turn. While within 5 ft of you, marked creature has Disadvantage on attacks against targets other than you. If it hits an ally, you have Advantage on attack rolls against it until end of your next turn.
At 7th level, Reaction to add 1d8 to AC of self or ally within 5 ft against an attack. If it still hits, target gains Resistance to the damage. Uses equal to Con modifier per Long Rest.

activation.condition: Quando você ou aliado a até 1,5m é atingido

description.value: At 10th level, creatures provoke Opportunity Attacks when moving 5 ft or more within your reach. Hitting with an Opportunity Attack reduces target’s Speed to 0 for the turn.
At 15th level, in the first round of combat, you and your mount gain +10 ft Speed and do not provoke Opportunity Attacks. Moving within 5 ft forces a Str save or pushed 5 ft / knocked Prone.
At 18th level, gain a special Reaction once on every creature’s turn except your own, usable only to make Opportunity Attacks.
At 3rd level, you gain proficiency in Performance (or another Monk skill) and Brewer’s Supplies.
At 3rd level, whenever you use Flurry of Blows, your Speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the current turn and your movement doesn’t provoke Opportunity Attacks.
At 6th level, stand from Prone for 5 ft movement. When a melee attack misses you, spend 1 Focus Point as a Reaction to redirect it to hit another creature within 5 ft of you.

activation.condition: Quando ataque corpo a corpo erra você

description.value: At 6th level, brew magical beverages after a rest (1 hr duration, or 8 hrs for 1 Focus Point): Cinnamon Dragon (30-ft cone 4 Martial Arts dice Fire damage + Poisoned), Heavenly Spirit (Psychic and Radiant resistance), Refreshing Dip (+1 Martial Arts die when regaining HP).
At 11th level, add to Mystic Brew: Blue Lightning (make an Unarmed Strike as part of reactions that aren't OAs or spells) and Drunkard’s Luck (gain Heroic Inspiration when rolling Initiative).
At 17th level, when you use Flurry of Blows, you can make up to three additional Unarmed Strikes with it (up to a total of six), provided that each strike targets a different creature this turn.

At 3rd level, as a Bonus Action, spend one Channel Divinity to summon skeletons or zombies equal to half your Charisma modifier (min 1) for 1 minute within 30 ft. They act immediately after you and obey commands.

At 3rd level, immediately after casting Divine Smite, spend one Channel Divinity: each creature of choice in a 30-foot Emanation must succeed on a Wisdom save or have the Frightened condition for 1 minute.

At 3rd level, you always have Oathbreaker Spells prepared: 3rd: Hellish Rebuke, Witch Bolt; 5th: Crown of Madness, Darkness; 9th: Fear, Summon Undead; 13th: Blight, Phantasmal Killer; 17th: Contagion, Steel Wind Strike.
At 7th level, when you or an allied Fiend or Undead in your Aura of Protection hits with a melee attack, it deals extra Necrotic damage equal to your Charisma modifier.
At 15th level, you gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.

At 20th level, as a Bonus Action, empower your Aura of Protection for 10 minutes (recharges on Long Rest or 5th-level spell slot): magical Darkness fills aura (you and allies can see through it); Frightened creatures starting turns in aura take 4d10 Psychic damage; Bonus Action Shadow Strike deals 3d10+Cha Necrotic damage to a target in aura.
